hero.lead: Interactive courses where every idea has a picture you can move and a few lines of Python you can run. No paywall.

one.title: Figures you can move
one.body: Drag a matrix and watch the plane bend with it. The intuition comes from your hands, not from a paragraph.

two.title: Python that runs
two.body: Every idea ends in the three or four lines of NumPy that do the same thing, so the maths and the code never drift apart.

three.title: No paywall
three.body: The whole course is here, in the open. No sign-up, no drip feed, no upsell at lesson four.
